incident.incidentDescription: At 22:15 UTC on 10 May 2026 the core banking storage array became unresponsive. Confirmed supply-chain ransomware attack via trojanised StorageCorp firmware v4.2.1. Full service restored 11 May 2026 06:00 UTC. No data exfiltration confirmed. 87,500 clients and 142 financial counterparts were affected.
incident.originatesFromThirdPartyProvider: StorageCorp firmware update v4.2.1 (deployed 2026-05-09) confirmed as the attack vector. StorageCorp notified; joint investigation concluded 2026-05-18.

incidentType.otherIncidentClassification: Combination of ransomware propagation and cascading infrastructure failure not fully captured by existing classification categories.
incidentType.otherThreatTechniques: Use of a previously unknown firmware-level persistence mechanism on storage controllers.
incidentType.indicatorsOfCompromise: C2 domains: malicious-c2-domain.ru, 185.220.101.45. Hashes: SHA256:a3f1... (ransomware payload), SHA256:b9c2... (lateral movement tool). Registry key: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\svchost.exe.

classificationTypes.memberStatesImpactTypeDescription: Incident affected retail and corporate banking clients across seven EU member states through shared core banking infrastructure.

classificationTypes.dataLossesDescription: Transaction records for 2026-05-10 were temporarily unavailable for 4 hours. Integrity of 12,000 records was verified post-restoration. No exfiltration confirmed.

classificationTypes.economicImpactMaterialityThreshold: Above 1% of total annual net revenue

classificationTypes.reputationalImpactDescription: Incident covered by three national financial news outlets. Over 4,000 complaints received from retail clients unable to access mobile banking.

incident.rootCausesOther: Absence of cryptographic integrity verification for vendor-supplied firmware packages was a contributing factor not fully covered by existing detailed categories.
incident.rootCausesInformation: The trojanised firmware passed standard signature checks because StorageCorp's code-signing key was compromised at the vendor's build server. Acm Bank's patch management process did not include independent binary integrity verification. Internal change advisory board approved the update without a mandatory staging-environment test for firmware-class updates.
incident.incidentResolutionSummary: Full service restored via DR site activation. Affected storage array isolated and replaced. StorageCorp provided a clean firmware build (v4.2.2). All systems returned to primary site by 2026-05-13 after full forensic sweep. No customer data loss or exfiltration confirmed by two independent forensic firms.
incident.incidentResolutionVsPlannedImplementatio: DR activation was completed within the 8-hour RTO defined in the BCP, though 2 hours behind the initial internal target due to unexpected dependency on a third-party authentication service that required manual failover.
incident.assessmentOfRiskToCriticalFunctions: Risk to payment processing critical function assessed as temporarily elevated during the incident window. Post-restoration controls verified. No residual risk to critical functions identified.
incident.informationRelevantToResolutionAuthoriti: No insolvency or liquidity impact identified. Capital ratios remained above regulatory minimums throughout the incident. Resolution plan critical functions were not impaired beyond the 14.5-hour window.
incident.recurringNonMajorIncidentsDescription: Three minor storage performance events occurred in the 12 months prior (refs: ACM-FR-2025-0018, ACM-FR-2025-0031, ACM-FR-2026-0007), each resolved within 30 minutes. None were assessed as related to the current supply-chain vector.
incident.otherInformation: Coordination with Europol cybercrime unit ongoing. StorageCorp has issued a security advisory to all customers. Acm Bank is participating in the sector-wide ISAC information sharing exercise on supply-chain firmware risks.

impactAssessment.criticalServicesAffected: Core banking platform (CBS), retail internet banking portal, mobile banking application, SEPA credit transfer processing, intraday liquidity reporting.
impactAssessment.affectedFunctionalAreas: Retail banking operations, corporate treasury, payment processing, risk management reporting, compliance data feeds.
impactAssessment.affectedInfrastructureComponents: Primary data centre storage array (vendor: StorageCorp, model: SC-9000), backup replication controllers, network segmentation layer between DMZ and internal banking network.

serviceImpact.descriptionOfTemporaryActionsMeasuresFor: Manual transaction processing activated for priority corporate clients. Read-only mode enabled on internet banking. Backup CBS instance brought online at DR site after 6 hours. Temporary SEPA cut-off extension requested from national central bank.
